important_issues: 8 GB RAM / 4 performance cores: parallel speed-up measured at most 2.5x (8 workers); single runs above ~2 M configurations unsafe
a seed-job exception aborts the whole run (runner.run_conditions: unguarded f.result()); xzr run is not resumable (studies are, via persisted jobs)

seed count: presets validator caps at 16 (xzr/presets/__init__.py MAX_SEEDS); history statistics enumerate 2^seeds
